name: bitdrift
description: First-party bitdrift plugins for mobile and edge observability: the bd CLI, Capture SDK instrumentation, and the hosted MCP server.

plugins.name: bitdrift-cli
plugins.description: Operate the bitdrift Capture platform with the bd CLI: investigate crashes, sessions, and app health, author workflows and dashboards, and set up Critical User Journey monitoring.

plugins.name: bitdrift-sdk
plugins.description: Instrument iOS, Android, and React Native apps with the bitdrift Capture SDK, and look up bitdrift documentation.

plugins.name: bitdrift-mcp
plugins.description: Connect to bitdrift through its hosted MCP server. Sign in to bitdrift when connecting.
